sections.description:
The WordPress SEO Plugin That Creates Content

RepublishAI is the best WordPress SEO plugin that goes beyond optimization to create content. Our AI content generator researches keywords, writes SEO-optimized articles, and publishes automatically. sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Search for “RepublishAI” in WordPress plugins
  2. Click “Install Now” and activate
  3. Connect to RepublishAI dashboard
  4. Start your WordPress blog automation

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Upload via WordPress admin panel
  3. Activate the RepublishAI plugin
  4. Configure your AI content generator

Configuration

  1. Access RepublishAI in WordPress admin menu
  2. Create application password for secure connection
  3. Sign up at republishai.com for your account
  4. Connect your WordPress autoblogging plugin
sections.faq:
Is this WordPress SEO plugin free?

The plugin is free to install. RepublishAI editor is free to use. For Autopilot autoblogging and AI content generator features, a subscription is required.

How does this autoblogging plugin differ from others?

This WordPress autoblogging plugin provides complete automation. Once configured, it handles keyword research, content creation, and publishing without manual work. Other plugins require constant prompting.

How many articles can the AI content generator create?

Our AI content generator for WordPress creates 30+ SEO-optimized articles monthly, depending on your autopilot settings.

Can I review AI-generated content before publishing?

Yes! Configure the autoblogging plugin to save as draft for review, or enable automatic publishing for complete SEO on autopilot.

Does it integrate with Yoast SEO?

Yes! This WordPress SEO plugin automatically generates and optimizes Yoast SEO meta titles, descriptions, and keywords.

How secure is this WordPress plugin?

We use WordPress application passwords for secure authentication. Your admin credentials are never shared, maintaining complete security.

Can I manage multiple WordPress sites?

Yes! This SEO plugin for WordPress supports unlimited site management from one dashboard.

What makes content SEO-optimized?

Our AI SEO writer analyzes top-ranking content, identifies gaps, optimizes keywords, adds internal links, generates alt text, and follows SEO best practices.

Do I need technical knowledge?

No! This WordPress blog automation plugin features an intuitive setup wizard that anyone can use.

How do I get support?

Visit republishai.com/support or contact through the RepublishAI dashboard for premium support.
